title: Evidence/reproducibility refresh: dry-run harness + binding drift-check
goal: Build the standalone verification script that resolves the Universal Router address discrepancy and continuously re-probes every external precondition this design depends on.
steps: Model scripts/verify-phase2-readiness.mjs on feasibility/verify-robinhood-binding.mjs's existing fail-closed pattern
Probe Collector Crypt's /api/status+/api/machines, Relay's /chains, Programmable's discovery/capabilities endpoints, and the Uniswap deployments page against a fresh finalized RPC read

Specifically resolve the Universal Router address: compare the repo-pinned 0x06afBA43fd06227fA663b0dAeCF536F6eaA6BF99 against Uniswap's public deployments page value 0x8876789976decbfcbbbe364623c63652db8c0904 for chain 4663 via an on-chain runtime-codehash probe, and report which one is actually live
Report INTEGRATION_PENDING/PASSED per precondition, never silently pass
Add a read-only, non-blocking CI job that re-runs this on a schedule (matches AGENTS.md's at-most-one-60-minute-or-slower-watchdog rule)
acceptance: Script reports which Universal Router address is actually live on-chain, with the evidence (runtime codehash comparison) recorded
Script reports INTEGRATION_PENDING vs PASSED for every one of this design's external preconditions
WP-20 cannot proceed with mining until this script reports the router address as resolved
notes: This package must complete before WP-20; none of the three source designs hard-blocked mining on this probe, which this synthesis explicitly fixes.
